flags: Designation scope: the catalog calls the whole road a Nevada State Scenic Byway, while chapter notes identify a promotional nickname. Cache 00 specifically confirms scenic-byway designation east of Ely; prose limits designation to that section.
Corrected current Austin claim: $250,000 was the eventual multistate campaign total, not money raised solely by the town in 1864. Cache 08 clarifies geography and beneficiary.
Corrected current implication that U.S. 50 follows the older routes continuously as far as Ely: paths diverge through the Desatoya Mountains. Kept the named trails distinct from the numbered highway.

Cache 00 gives Hickison as about 20 miles east of Austin; cache 03 and dedicated site cache 15 give 24. Exact distance omitted. Cache also disagrees on Ely–Delta distance and extent of nickname; no endpoint mileage asserted.

All three current moments retained in eastbound order, including Sand Mountain and Hickison. Sand Mountain had no current coordinates and remains without them. Story motif switchbacks retained. No present museum opening or off-highway driving access promised; only secondary cached sources are available for these sites.
